verdict.rationale: AWS's agent platform, Bedrock AgentCore, says it manages authentication and access control when an agent calls an MCP server. That is first-party, client-side MCP connectivity, but it is described in a single marketing sentence. The awslabs MCP servers are the server role and are not credited here. Missing for 10: documented steps for registering or plugging in arbitrary MCP servers, details of tool discovery and invocation, supported transports and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Your agent needs to call an MCP server, a knowledge base, an internal API, and a Lambda function in the same turn, and every connection needs to know who's calling and whether they're allowed. AgentCore helps you handle the authentication and access control
the end-to-end platform to build, connect and optimize highly capable agents securely
